title: 情報工学実験Ⅱ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Computer Programming Practice II
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the following three items. 1) The ability to use the Python language to create programs according to exercises. 2) The ability to search and use information such as language specifications, packages, and APIs. 3) The ability to write a concise program and explain the processing outline while considering program restrictions and readability.
advice: Python is a programming language widely used not only for education but also in the field of web services and artificial intelligence. Students use the knowledge learned in 'Programming I' and 'Programming II' for exercises and learn programming, software development, how to correct problems when they occur, and software development capabilities to realize the required functions through exercises. Students will be able to create programs that are easy to read and maintain, and learn to easily read the functional overview, program code, and execution results of others. Note: Bring your own laptop computer. You should make sure your laptop can connect to the campus network and use the network printer.
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to understand programming basics and object-oriented programming. If you are not good at programming, review 'Programming I, II, III", and "Computer Programming Practice I". In addition, it is desirable to be interested in technologies such as data structures, algorithms, databases, and networks.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create programs using the Python language.
Be able to explain the outline, input, processing, output, and constraints of the created program.
Be able to operate editors and develop programs efficiently.
Be able to implement the same process in multiple ways, and explain the advantages and disadvantages of them.
